title: [c10d] Add an explicit NCCL legacy backend
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #191272

It's incremental work towards switching the default for nccl backend.

> AI-assisted description:
>
> Add an `nccl-legacy` backend entry point that always creates the existing `ProcessGroupNCCL`. Keep `nccl` on that implementation by default, and select the `nccl2` creator when `TORCH_DIST_USE_NCCL2=1`.
>
> Update NCCL1-specific backend test matrices to use `nccl-legacy` so they continue to test the existing implementation independently of the `nccl` default.
>
> Test Plan:
>
> ```bash
> BUILD_TEST=0 USE_FBGEMM=0 USE_NNPACK=0 USE_QNNPACK=0 USE_XNNPACK=0 USE_FLASH_ATTENTION=0 USE_MEM_EFF_ATTENTION=0 USE_DISTRIBUTED=1 USE_CUDA=1 MAX_JOBS=144 .venv/bin/pip install -e . -v --no-build-isolation
> CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 NCCL_DEBUG=WARN NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0 .venv/bin/python test/distributed/test_c10d_collectives.py -v
> CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 NCCL_DEBUG=WARN NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0 .venv/bin/python test/distributed/test_c10d_p2p.py -v
> CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2,3 NCCL_DEBUG=WARN NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0 .venv/bin/python test/distributed/test_c10d_cuda_graphs.py -v
> CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2,3 NCCL_DEBUG=WARN NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0 .venv/bin/python test/distributed/test_c10d_process_group.py -v
> CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2,3 NCCL_DEBUG=WARN NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0 .venv/bin/python test/distributed/test_c10d_suspend_resume.py -v
> .venv/bin/python test/distributed/test_c10d_common.py BackendEntryPointTest -v
> spin quicklint
> lintrunner -a
> ```
>
> This change was authored with assistance from an AI coding assistant.
